integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Sweet music video style, live‑action, a medium close‑up shot frames a woman with long dark hair styled in two braids, wearing a white short‑sleeved dress with a collar, standing on a sandy beach with the ocean and a clear blue sky in the background. The lighting is bright and natural daytime seaside sunlight. At the start, she stands centered in the frame with the background slightly blurred to emphasize her presence. As the shot progresses, she performs consistent lateral horizontal movement, walking slowly sideways along the shoreline parallel to the sea, feet stepping lightly on beach sand, occasionally glancing toward the camera with soft sweet smile. Her hair and dress hem flutter gently in sea breeze, movements are fluid and rhythmic. The camera follows her horizontal movement steadily, maintaining constant framing, keeps her centered within frame at all times, she intermittently turns her head to make eye contact with viewer, subtle body sway while walking, no forward walking toward or away from camera.

overall_soundscape: Gentle waves crash softly against the shore in the background, accompanied by faint rustle of sand underfoot. Light soft footsteps sound as she walks, mixed with subtle wind sound brushing through her long hair. The overall ambiance is calm and serene, no abrupt or loud noises.

non_diegetic_music: A soft, melodic piano‑driven track at moderate tempo, light string accompaniment that swells gently when she looks toward camera. Dreamy romantic tone all through, smooth transitions, slow fade‑out toward end of the 5‑second clip.
